mapper.sql: pid, pname, ptype, pdatetime, pprice, ppic, pdesc, area_id, latitude, longitude, trim_period_days, fertilize_period_days, water_period_days, pest_period_days, next_trim_date, next_fertilize_date, next_water_date, next_pest_date
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plant ORDER BY pdatetime DESC, pid ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE plant SET pname = #{pname}, ptype = #{ptype}, pdatetime = #{pdatetime}, pprice = #{pprice}, ppic = #{ppic}, pdesc = #{pdesc}, area_id = #{areaId}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, trim_period_days = #{trimPeriodDays}, fertilize_period_days = #{fertilizePeriodDays}, water_period_days = #{waterPeriodDays}, pest_period_days = #{pestPeriodDays}, next_trim_date = #{nextTrimDate}, next_fertilize_date = #{nextFertilizeDate}, next_water_date = #{nextWaterDate}, next_pest_date = #{nextPestDate} WHERE pid = #{pid}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant WHERE (next_trim_date IS NOT NULL AND next_trim_date <= CURDATE()) OR (next_fertilize_date IS NOT NULL AND next_fertilize_date <= CURDATE()) OR (next_water_date IS NOT NULL AND next_water_date <= CURDATE()) OR (next_pest_date IS NOT NULL AND next_pest_date <= CURDATE())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant p WHERE p.area_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM maintainer_plant mp WHERE mp.pid = p.pid AND mp.status = '有效' )

SELECT p.pid, p.pname, p.ptype, p.pdatetime, p.pprice, p.ppic, p.pdesc, p.area_id, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.trim_period_days, p.fertilize_period_days, p.water_period_days, p.pest_period_days, p.next_trim_date, p.next_fertilize_date, p.next_water_date, p.next_pest_date FROM plant p INNER JOIN maintainer_plant mp ON mp.pid = p.pid WHERE mp.maintainer_id = #{maintainerId} AND mp.status = '有效' ORDER BY p.pname ASC

SELECT p.pid, p.pname AS plant_name, t.task_type, t.due_date, m.name AS maintainer_name FROM plant p LEFT JOIN maintainer_plant mp ON mp.pid = p.pid AND mp.status = '有效' AND mp.is_primary = 1 LEFT JOIN maintainer m ON m.id = mp.maintainer_id JOIN ( SELECT pid, '修剪' AS task_type, next_trim_date AS due_date FROM plant WHERE next_trim_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT pid, '施肥' AS task_type, next_fertilize_date AS due_date FROM plant WHERE next_fertilize_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT pid, '施水' AS task_type, next_water_date AS due_date FROM plant WHERE next_water_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT pid, '除害' AS task_type, next_pest_date AS due_date FROM plant WHERE next_pest_date IS NOT NULL ) t ON t.pid = p.pid WHERE t.due_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{daysAhead} DAY) ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, p.pname ASC
